items.summary: Seed the backend with the following three bikes if the catalog is empty: (1) Yamaha R15 — price ₹1,80,000, engine 155cc, mileage 40 km/l, image https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1609630875171-b1321377ee65; (2) KTM Duke 390 — price ₹3,10,000, engine 373cc, mileage 28 km/l, image https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1617814076668-7d9f5bff031f; (3) Royal Enfield Classic 350 — price ₹1,95,000, engine 349cc, mileage 35 km/l, image https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1597008858255-6c1b16ef5b24.
Ensure the catalog page and bike cards display the engine capacity (e.g., '155cc') and mileage (e.g., '40 km/l') fields alongside price for each bike, using the data fetched from the backend.

Display the Unsplash image URLs provided for each bike as the bike photo in both the catalog card and detail page. Use the exact URLs: Yamaha R15 → https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1609630875171-b1321377ee65, KTM Duke 390 → https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1617814076668-7d9f5bff031f, Royal Enfield Classic 350 → https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1597008858255-6c1b16ef5b24.
